name: What is the typical process for an attic conversion with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for an attic conversion with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your attic's potential. We then move into detailed design planning, including CAD-supported layouts, to visualize the new space. Following design approval, we handle all necessary permit coordination. The construction phase involves structural work, insulation, electrical, plumbing (if applicable), and finishes. Throughout, we maintain clear communication, providing a single point of coordination from concept to final walkthrough, ensuring a managed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, detailed design planning, permit coordination, construction, and final walkthrough, all managed by AKN Design Group.
